map.当某行视标在检查距离 D（米）处所对视角为 5 弧分时，对应最佳矫正视力 1.0: When a row's optotype subtends 5 arcmin at test distance D (m), it corresponds to best-corrected vision 1.0 (6/6 or 20/20). That row's letter height H = D × tan(5′) ÷ decimal vision v, with tan(5′) ≈ 0.0014544. E.g. at 6 m the 6/6 row letter is ~8.7 mm tall. The tool converts mm to pixels via your screen PPI (pixel density); scaling only affects on-screen appearance, while the labeled mm stays the true physical size. Enter accurate PPI and set display scale to 100% to match a real chart's optotype size on screen.
